contaminationNote: Historical 2019Q2 replay built in September 2026 with current model/search weights. Only evidence available by 2019-06-30 is frozen; current-model/search contamination remains uncontrolled.

lanes.purpose: Official policy, licensing, trade-control and macro evidence.
lanes.limitations: Selected central-government and U.S. Commerce releases; no exhaustive official crawl.
Selected issuer quarterly filings and cutoff-valid guidance/research were frozen; no exhaustive A-share company crawl.
NBS food prices and TrendForce semiconductor demand/price evidence.
Xinhua 5G reporting used as an independent news origin.

sourceItems.title: 工业和信息化部向四家企业颁发5G牌照
normalizedClaims: MIIT formally licensed China Telecom, China Mobile, China Unicom and China Broadcasting Network to operate 5G services, marking the start of commercial deployment.
observedChanges: commercial 5G moves from trial/policy expectation into licensed deployment

sourceItems.title: 我国正式发放5G商用牌照
sourceItems.publisher: 新华社（中央网信办转载）
normalizedClaims: Xinhua reported that China entered the 5G commercial era after licenses were issued, with network construction and industry applications expected to accelerate.
observedChanges: 5G commercial deployment becomes an observable national event

sourceItems.title: Department of Commerce Announces the Addition of Huawei Technologies Co. Ltd. to the Entity List
normalizedClaims: U.S. Commerce announced Huawei and affiliates would be added to the Entity List, materially increasing supply-chain and technology-access uncertainty.
observedChanges: Huawei supply chain faces a new external restriction

sourceItems.title: The US-China Trade War Rages On: DRAM Price Decline 3Q to Widen to 15%
normalizedClaims: TrendForce widened its 3Q DRAM price-decline forecast to 10-15% because Huawei smartphone/server shipments and data-center demand were expected to weaken.
observedChanges: memory physical demand outlook worsens despite domestic-substitution narrative

sourceItems.title: Global Top Ten Foundries for 2Q19 Perform Less-than-expected Due to Sliding Demand and High Inventories
normalizedClaims: TrendForce estimated top-ten foundry 2Q revenue down about 8% YoY as demand weakened and inventories remained high; Huawei restrictions added further 2H uncertainty.
observedChanges: broad semiconductor demand remains weak even as localization pressure rises

sourceItems.title: 国家发展改革委有关负责人就稀土产业发展相关问题答记者问
normalizedClaims: NDRC highlighted rare earths as a strategic resource, stressed priority for domestic needs, and addressed the possibility of using the sector within the U.S.-China trade dispute without announcing an export ban.
observedChanges: rare-earth policy attention and strategic value sharply rise

sourceItems.title: 政策研究室副主任兼委新闻发言人孟玮答问之二：关于促进稀土产业高质量发展的措施
normalizedClaims: NDRC said it had held three recent meetings with experts, major companies and local governments to study policies and stronger sector regulation, confirming sustained policy attention but not a concrete export cutoff.
observedChanges: rare-earth policy discussion broadens from rhetoric to policy consultation

sourceItems.title: 深化收费公路制度改革取消高速公路省界收费站实施方案
sourceItems.publisher: 国务院办公厅（财政部公开）
normalizedClaims: The State Council plan required toll-system/ETC hardware and software upgrades to be largely completed by October 2019, system testing by December, and ETC use at expressway entrances to reach 90% by year end.
observedChanges: a national infrastructure deadline creates a finite but measurable equipment/order cycle

sourceItems.title: 关于十三届全国人大二次会议第7822号建议的答复函
normalizedClaims: MOT reiterated the timetable: engineering completion by October, system integration/testing in November-December, and readiness for system switching by year end.
observedChanges: the ETC implementation deadline remains intact and operational

sourceItems.title: 关于公布2019年第一批风电、光伏发电平价上网项目的通知
sourceItems.publisher: 国家发展改革委/国家能源局
normalizedClaims: The first 2019 wind/solar grid-parity project list totaled 20.76GW and required grid companies to support connections and guaranteed acquisition under long-term fixed-price contracts.
observedChanges: grid-parity projects move from framework policy into a concrete project list

sourceItems.title: 国家能源局关于2019年风电、光伏发电项目建设有关事项的通知
normalizedClaims: NEA prioritized grid-parity projects and launched competitive allocation for subsidized projects, while requiring grid connection and consumption conditions.
observedChanges: 2019 PV construction policy becomes executable after earlier policy uncertainty

sourceItems.title: 2019年5月份居民消费价格同比上涨2.7%
normalizedClaims: May pork prices were +18.2% YoY, confirming a developing hog-supply shortage while month-on-month prices were roughly flat.
observedChanges: pork scarcity is visible but not yet at the later 2019 extreme

sourceItems.title: Uncertainties in the Market Rise while a Bounce in NAND Flash Prices Remains Unlikely in 3Q
normalizedClaims: NAND contract prices had fallen about 20% QoQ for two consecutive quarters and TrendForce still did not expect a 3Q rebound because smartphones, servers and notebooks remained weak.
observedChanges: memory downcycle remains active despite technology-policy headlines

eventClusters.statement: China moved 5G from trial/policy preparation into formal commercial licensing on June 6, potentially accelerating network equipment and optical demand.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Licensing itself does not prove incremental capex or earnings. Deep research must verify operator procurement/order conversion and whether listed suppliers already rerated before the license.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which A-share 5G expressions had measurable order/earnings conversion and expectation room at June 30?

eventClusters.statement: Huawei's Entity List restriction created a simultaneous localization incentive and near-term demand/supply shock; contemporaneous memory/foundry data remained weak, so 'domestic substitution' and 'electronics demand' must be split rather than averaged.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The policy shock can benefit localization over a long horizon while simultaneously reducing Huawei/device demand and worsening memory/foundry utilization in the near term. V1.5 must create separate company/product hypotheses before any selection.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Can any domestic supplier show a company-specific order/share engine strong enough to overcome the near-term electronics demand shock, or should the broad theme fail closed?

eventClusters.statement: Rare earths became a high-profile strategic-policy topic during escalating trade friction, with NDRC conducting repeated policy consultations; however no export ban or quantified production cut was announced.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Policy attention is real but economic transmission is ambiguous without quotas, exports or price/volume evidence. Separate resource owners, processors and downstream magnets; do not equate strategic rhetoric with earnings.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Did any listed rare-earth company have a direct, under-reflected earnings bridge by June 30, or was the theme mostly expectation repricing?

eventClusters.statement: The State Council converted toll-station reform into a national ETC hardware/software construction program with explicit October and year-end deadlines.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The opportunity has unusually explicit timing but also an unusually explicit expiry. V1.5 should test whether order/earnings conversion occurs before normalization without treating the finite cycle as a long-duration compounder.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which listed ETC suppliers had verified orders/capacity and a base-horizon catalyst that occurred before the deployment wave expired?

eventClusters.statement: After prior policy uncertainty, 2019 solar construction rules became executable through a 20.76GW first parity-project list and a formal parity-first/competitive-bidding framework.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Policy restart does not imply equal benefit across upstream/downstream. Deep research must separate project-volume beneficiaries from segments still facing price pressure or overcapacity.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which PV companies had a direct earnings bridge from the 2019 project restart rather than only generic sector beta?

eventClusters.statement: By May, pork prices were already +18.2% YoY, indicating a developing hog-supply shortage before the later 2019 extreme scarcity phase.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The price signal is earlier than the Q3/Q4 extremes but month-on-month pricing was not yet accelerating strongly. Deep research must verify producer volumes/costs and avoid assuming future scarcity severity.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Were any low-cost hog producers already converting the emerging price regime into measurable earnings before June 30?

eventClusters.statement: DRAM and NAND physical markets remained in a pronounced downcycle in June, with Huawei restrictions worsening smartphone/server uncertainty and memory prices still expected to fall.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: This is a negative physical signal that should remain separate from long-run semiconductor localization. Generic semiconductor price momentum may not override a missing positive product-level earnings bridge.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Should broad memory exposure remain No selection at June 30 despite domestic-substitution narratives?

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff 5G price regime
normalizedClaims: 5G basket was neutral: +1.55pp 20d excess and -3.94pp 60d excess with only one-third positive breadth; ZTE itself was strong while FiberHome/Accelink were weak.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff semiconductor-theme price regime
normalizedClaims: Semiconductor basket was neutral: +7.83pp 20d excess and +0.24pp 60d excess, but only one-third of names beat CSI300 over 60d; price strength was concentrated.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff rare-earth price regime
normalizedClaims: Rare-earth basket had -7.42pp 20d excess but +12.05pp 60d excess; every frozen name lagged CSI300 in the final 20d after a strong prior policy-driven rerating.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff ETC price regime
normalizedClaims: ETC basket was favorable with +8.34pp 20d and +42.45pp 60d excess; JinYi had +84.72pp 60d excess and Wanji +50.71pp, showing very high expectation absorption before cutoff.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff PV price regime
normalizedClaims: PV basket was neutral: -8.13pp 20d excess but +4.42pp 60d excess; Longi and Tongwei retained positive 60d excess while all three frozen names lagged over the final 20d.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff pork-equity price regime
normalizedClaims: Pork basket was neutral: -12.10pp 20d excess and +4.87pp 60d excess; only New Hope beat CSI300 over 60d while all three names lagged in the final 20d.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff generic memory-theme price regime
normalizedClaims: Generic memory-theme basket was neutral/weak: -2.59pp 20d and -5.83pp 60d excess; neither frozen name beat CSI300 over 60d.

evidenceDocuments.title: 中兴通讯2019年第一季度报告
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue RMB22.20bn -19.34%; attributable profit RMB862.6m after the prior-year sanction loss;扣非 RMB132.9m; operating cash flow RMB1.260bn versus -RMB171m.

evidenceDocuments.title: 中兴通讯：业绩增长稳健，国内市场广阔叠加5G技术领先，5G商用扬帆起航
normalizedClaims: Report forecast 2019/20/21 EPS 1.11/1.76/2.48 and PE 27.3x/17.24x/12.19 at RMB30.28; expected 2019 H1 attributable profit RMB1.2-1.8bn and argued 5G licensing would accelerate operator capital spending.

evidenceDocuments.title: 华为或迎转机 | MWC热点回顾 | 中报展望
normalizedClaims: At June 28 prices the report showed ZTE 2019/20/21 EPS 1.10/1.40/1.94 at PE 29.57x/23.24x/16.77; FiberHome 0.87/1.14/1.42 at PE 32.02x/24.44x/19.62; sector expectations already reflected ongoing 5G buildout.

evidenceDocuments.title: 烽火通信2019年第一季度报告
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue RMB4.881bn +14.90%, attributable profit RMB166.7m +19.71%,扣非 +21.19%; operating cash flow remained negative RMB1.703bn but improved 41.38%.

evidenceDocuments.title: 光迅科技2019年第一季度报告
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue RMB1.219bn +0.99%; attributable profit RMB63.93m -17.80%;扣非 profit was positive year-on-year while headline profit remained down.

evidenceDocuments.title: 金溢科技2019年第一季度报告
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue RMB145.45m -3.41%, attributable profit RMB9.40m +35.85%,扣非 +25.80%; operating cash flow remained negative. The then-current H1 forecast was only RMB8-13m profit.

evidenceDocuments.title: 金溢科技：重量级政策出台，深度利好ETC行业龙头
normalizedClaims: At RMB28.88 the report set RMB35.19 target and forecast 2019/20/21 revenue RMB2.185/2.576/3.220bn, net profit RMB180/216/258m, EPS 1.53/1.83/2.19 and PE 18.87x/15.75x/13.18; expected policy-driven ETC orders to surge in June-July.

evidenceDocuments.title: 金溢科技2019年1-6月业绩预告（4月26日版本）
normalizedClaims: The cutoff-valid H1 guidance was only RMB8-13m attributable profit; the later July 12 upgrade to RMB42-48m was not available by the simulated cutoff and is explicitly excluded.

evidenceDocuments.title: 万集科技2019年第一季度报告
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue RMB117.27m +56.02%; attributable result remained a RMB16.05m loss, so the policy ramp had not yet produced realized profitability by cutoff.

evidenceDocuments.title: 万集科技：ETC渗透率提升带来业绩高弹性
normalizedClaims: Report forecast 2019/20/21 EPS 0.73/0.98/1.29 and highlighted ETC penetration/toll-station reform, but the earnings improvement remained forecast rather than realized at cutoff.

evidenceDocuments.title: 隆基股份2019年第一季度报告
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue RMB5.710bn +64.56%, attributable profit RMB611m +12.54%,扣非 +17.81%, and operating cash flow turned to +RMB938m from -RMB717m; higher wafer/module volumes drove the revenue increase.

evidenceDocuments.title: 风光明媚：光伏竞价或超预期，风电抢装如火如荼
normalizedClaims: At June 28 prices the contemporaneous forecast showed Longi 2019/20/21 EPS 1.21/1.63/2.04 and PE about 19.1x/14.2x/11.3x, while policy competition/project expectations were improving.

evidenceDocuments.title: 通威股份：业绩符合申万宏源预期，综合竞争力领先行业
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue RMB6.169bn +18.14% and profit RMB491m +53.36%; report forecast 2019/20/21 profit RMB3.286/3.992/4.540bn, EPS 0.85/1.03/1.17 and PE 16x/13x/12x at RMB13.83.

evidenceDocuments.title: 阳光电源2019年第一季度报告
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue grew about 30.1% while attributable profit fell about 15.6%, making the company a weaker earnings-conversion expression for the same policy restart.

evidenceDocuments.title: 北方华创2019年第一季度报告
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue RMB708m +30.51%, attributable profit +29.65%, but扣非 profit was -RMB22.48m and deteriorated 87.76%, so headline growth did not establish a clean post-restriction localization earnings engine.

evidenceDocuments.title: 兆易创新2019年第一季度报告
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue RMB456m -15.73%, attributable profit -55.58% and扣非 -62.03%, consistent with the weak physical memory/electronics cycle.

evidenceDocuments.title: 韦尔股份2019年第一季度报告
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue RMB723m -11.84%, attributable profit +19.10%,扣非 +19.39%; operating cash flow remained negative, giving mixed rather than broad semiconductor confirmation.

evidenceDocuments.title: 盛和资源2019年第一季度报告
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue +15.34%, attributable profit -54.81%,扣非 -56.10%, and operating cash flow deteriorated sharply, so strategic-resource rhetoric had not converted into current earnings.

evidenceDocuments.title: 北方稀土2019年第一季度报告
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue +30.98% largely from trading activity, attributable profit +9.66%,扣非 -10.02%, and operating cash flow -54.69%; current operating evidence did not show a strong resource-price earnings inflection.

evidenceDocuments.title: 牧原股份2019年第一季度报告
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue RMB3.048bn +10.62% but attributable result was a RMB541m loss versus RMB136m profit a year earlier; the May pork-price rise had not yet converted into reported earnings by cutoff.
